As a bonus action, you can veil yourself in the Force for up to a minute, or until you're incapacitated. While the veil holds, the first time each turn a creature tries to target you with an attack, it must succeed on a Charisma save (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). On a failure, the attack fizzles, and the attacker must redirect at a different target or lose the attack entirely. On a success, the attack proceeds, but that creature has disadvantage on any save it makes against your powers on your next turn.

You must finish a short or long rest before using this feature again.
